comments.author: Daemon
comments.body:
Booster not listed: Cretan Royal Family's Bracelet. Obtained thru "Civilization preserved in the Labyrinth" MA. The MA is finished with 3 items, Cretan Loincloth + Corselet Dress + Cretan Headdress, I'm 100% sure it can be finished by running Labyrinth with one of the two Treasure Hunts active (no need to finish them).

You can't obtain the MA equipments without the active Treasure Hunt. With certain titles (B.C or Mythical?) you can craft some of this gear in Candia NPC's but haven't tested if they count for the MA.

Durability 100, Formality 30, No effect. Art Trading +2, Accounts +2, Metal Trading +1. Req Fame 10000.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Unlisted boosts:

+3 Body:
Robe de Soiree (male-only)
Robe de Mariee (female-only)

These were only available in the UWC shop/cove in the past. Unless they're re-released, you cannot find them except from players that own them.

+2 Accessory:
Cretan Royal Family's Bracelet
Blue Gem Necklace

The Cretan item is a Memorial Album reward. Pretty much a copy of the Celadon Flower Vase in terms of Art trading, but with the Metal/Accounts boost values reversed. The Blue Gem necklace is only obtainable from hidden treasure room chests in the Temple of Poseidon -- which is not always accessible in-game.

+1 Hat:
Cretan Hair Accessory (female-only)
Phrygian Cap

The first hat can be crafted can be crafted in Candia as detailed in its comment section. The second can be produced at Florence as detailed in its comment section.

I believe there is a +1 Hand item as well. Don't recall where it comes from though. Perhaps someone else will be kind enough to post that info. Cheers.
